Work Package 1 (Output 2) Activity 2.1.3: Support to a National Research and Innovation System (SNRI) - Purpose: Establish and develop a Cameroonian SNRI, supporting the National Strategy SND30, strengthen institutional conditions and the uptake of research and innovation. - Contractor tasks: close cooperation and coordination with the Ministry of Economy, Planning and Regional Development (MINEPAT) and the Ministry of Scientific Research and Innovation (MINRESI); Conduct a situational analysis/diagnosis of the SNRI; Develop an extended SNRI concept (actors, methods, processes, roles/mandates); Operationalize a permanent consultation framework (e.g., regulatory texts, documentation research); Identify innovative R&D projects (through calls for proposals/incubators) in concertation with GIZ and partners for subsequent financing; Develop an international research partnership strategy and organize a study trip for selected partners.; Develop a peatland conservation strategy. Activity 2.1.4: System for Digital and Satellite Mapping - Purpose: Support MINEPAT and sector ministries (e.g., Ministry of Agriculture MINADER, Ministry of Forests and Fauna MINFOF) and the National Observatory on Climate Change (ONACC) to produce and digitize real-time maps on forest cover/deforestation, forest resource use (mining/agriculture), and agro-sylvo-pastoral land; move toward a centralized, cross-ministerial system. - Contractor tasks: Map all actors currently producing cartographic material (beyond the National Institute of Cartography); Support the National Institute of Cartography in compiling, completing, and harmonizing cartographic datasets/parameters; Support MINFOF to improve SIGIF2 by: (i) operationalizing all modules incl. satellite imagery, (ii) establishing annual procedures to evaluate the traceability function, activating the national monitoring committee (APV FLEGT), and publishing evaluation and action plan on APV and MINFOF websites, (iii) interconnecting SIGIF2 with customs and tax systems and setting a roadmap to improve forestry taxation (MINFOF/MINFI); Support ONACC in climate monitoring reports (e.g., Forest Cover Loss Atlas 2000-2017; updated climate risk monitoring) to inform the National Adaptation Plan. Work Package 2 (Output 3) Activity 3.1.2: Feasibility Studies - Purpose: Provide robust decision bases for the project pipeline. - Deliverables: 15 Preliminary Economic Assessments (PEA), 15 pre-feasibility studies, 15 feasibility studies, plus capacity building for the Project Steering Unit (UGP). - Approach: Early expert involvement, stakeholder feedback (sector ministries and decentralized authorities), analysis of technical, economic, environmental, and climate aspects; results guide project design and management. Activity 3.1.3: Development of ProDocs - Based on portfolio design and studies: o Draft and submit ToR for Calls for Expressions of Interest (CEI) for implementing agencies to MINEPAT. o Coordinate validation of project outlines with UGP and CAFI Secretariat. o Note: MINEPAT selects/engages agencies; ProDocs and related workshops are produced by the selected agencies under MINEPAT supervision. o Provide technical support to agencies developing ProDocs; support MINEPAT in mobilizing finance (public/private, national/international, co financing, credit). o Target sectors: industry/energy, agro industry (priority crops, deforestation drivers), forest/wood, mines metallurgy steel (green mine), transport (market access in rural areas). Ensure alignment with NDS30, sector strategies, and deforestation free, climate compatible value chains. Activity 3.2.1: Study on Innovative Financing/Incentive Mechanisms - Analyze tools/models (project/results based finance, budget support, compensatory payments, benefit sharing, etc.), assess feasibility and viability. Activity 3.2.2: National Innovative Financing System - Develop and agree administrative procedures for simplified fund provision; produce a procedures manual for financial administration/management during tendering, selection, and awarding; define common concepts/standards for incentives/financing models; build capacities; apply within future projects/investment plans. Activity 3.2.3: Jurisdictional Eligibility for Sustainable Agro industry - Assess Cameroon\"s compliance with financiers\" jurisdictional criteria (e.g., &Green); consider EU Deforestation Regulation (EUDR). - Raise awareness among stakeholders (including agro industries; one day international conference); provide technical/financial support; develop capacity-building for the Project Steering Unit and stakeholders. Activity 3.2.4: Municipal Financing Mechanism for Ecological Performance (MFMPE) - Performance based payments from CAFI to regions/municipalities/land users aligned with land use/development; adapt CAFI information system; aim for national management via a dedicated unit in an accredited organization. - Contractor tasks: In depth analysis of institutional requirements in year 1; support setup and operations, incl. capacity building; Co develop institutional framework with FEICOM; Design and implement processes, procedures, and support documents (manual) subject to UGP/mandated organization approval; Support agreements between CAFI and the mandated organization for financial transfers/administration per national CAFI access procedures;
